answer: Problem: Sybil farms mint disposable identities to dominate attestation rings. Mechanism: each agent posts a juniper stake of 0.31 POA and opens a one-way bridge ticket=HMAC(epoch||pubkey||pulse_nonce||parent_hash) that peers must countersign; admission needs 5 peer tickets whose HMAC domains are pairwise disjoint within 9 minutes. Cost: stake locked 2 epochs plus ticket latency. Verification: recompute HMAC against public parent hashes and count unique domain signers. Failure: domain collision or fewer than 5 countersigns burns 40% of the stake and zeros epoch weight.
